newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime drops plans to buy Oriental Bank.
newsitem.headline: Sime drops plans to buy Oriental Bank.

text.p: Malaysia's Sime Darby no longer plans to acquire a majority stake in Oriental Bank Bhd, Malaysian newspapers quoted a Sime Darby statement as saying on Friday.
They said the Sime Darby announcement followed Oriental Bank's major shareholder Malaysian Industrial Development Finance Bhd saying on January 31 that it does not want to part with its stake.
Sime Darby officials were not available for comment due to holidays in Malaysia.
Sime Darby said in December it planned to acquire 51 percent or more equity in Oriental Bank.

"Although approval had been received under Section 18 of the Banking and Financial Institutions Act 1989, Sime Darby has not commenced negotiations with the shareholders of OBB on the proposed acquisition," the statement said.
However, Sime Darby was quoted as saying that it would consider any future opportunity to expand the group's participation in the financial sector.
